name: Spirit AI
summary: Spirit AI (Qianxun Intelligence) is an embodied AI company founded in February 2024 that builds the Moz humanoid and its own vision-language-action models. It runs pilots with CATL and JD.com.
funding: Nearly 2 billion yuan across two back-to-back rounds announced February 2026; investors include Yunfeng Capital, HongShan, CATL, JD.com, Huawei and Xiaomi (Gasgoo).

sources.title: Spirit AI secures nearly 2 billion yuan in back-to-back funding rounds
